issues.detail: The Greek 'αμφιεννυσιν' (amphiennesin) means 'perish' or 'pass away.' The Vietnamese translation 'huống chi là các ngươi' (how much more so for you) implies a comparison of intensity/degree, but misses the specific verb of perishing. It should convey that God will cause you to perish just as He does the grass.

The Greek 'ου πολλω μαλλον' (ou pollō mallon) means 'not much more.' The Vietnamese 'huống chi' (how much more) suggests a greater degree of destruction, whereas the Greek indicates that the destruction of the people will be similar to (not significantly more than) the destruction of the grass.
